name: The Void Incursion
description: A tear in reality threatens to release creatures from beyond. Only the bravest Emissaries dare approach.

narrative.intro:
The air itself screams as you approach the Void Tear. Reality warps and bends, colors bleeding into impossible hues. Through the rift, you glimpse a realm of pure darkness where shapes move with terrible purpose.

The Void Echoes guild has tried and failed to seal this breach three times. Each attempt left fewer mages standing. Now they turn to you - not to seal it, but to retrieve the Anchor Stone that fell through during the last attempt. Without it, the breach will only grow.

This is no routine mission. This is a journey into nightmare.

choices.text: Leap through the tear without hesitation
Tie a rope to anchor yourself to reality
Invoke the Eternal Flame's protection before entering

A.text:
Your boldness catches the Void creatures off guard! You plunge into darkness, grab the Anchor Stone, and hurl yourself back through the tear - but not without cost. The Void leaves its mark on you, a shadow that will take time to fade.

The mission succeeds, but you feel... different. The Void Echoes seal the breach with the recovered stone.

You receive a standard reward, plus wary respect for your recklessness.

B.text:
The rope holds as you descend into impossibility. Time has no meaning here - you could have been searching for seconds or centuries. Finally, your hand closes around the Anchor Stone just as a tendril of darkness reaches for you.

You yank the rope three times. Your allies pull you back to reality, the Stone clutched to your chest. The breach seals with a sound like a dying scream.

The Void Echoes reward you generously for your methodical approach.

C.text:
You kneel and pray to the Eternal Flame. Golden light envelops you - a shield against the Void's corruption. When you step through the tear, the darkness RECOILS from your radiance.

The Anchor Stone lies in a nest of shadow-tendrils, but they cannot touch you. You walk through nightmare as if strolling through a garden, retrieve the Stone, and return unscathed. The Void creatures shriek in frustration as the breach seals.

You have done what mages could not. The Void Echoes bow before you, and the Order of Dawn sends their highest commendation. Your faith has been rewarded beyond measure.

void_walker.name: Void Walker
void_walker.description: Enter the Void and return alive

flame_blessed.name: Flame Blessed
flame_blessed.description: Enter the Void under the Eternal Flame's protection

lore_connection: The Void is the antithesis of the Eternal Flame - a realm of entropy and unbeing. The Void Echoes guild studies these incursions, walking a dangerous line between knowledge and corruption. Some say they have learned too much.
